name: YKW 02 — Browse & Cart Abandonment Recovery · v2 (RabbitMQ)

parameters.content:
## YKW 02 — abandon recovery

1. RabbitMQ `q.n8n.checkout-abandoned`
2. Normalize → DEMO send window
3. Order/viewer → skip if paid/owned/no contact
4. Recs → bundle → offer link
5. **OpenRouter** personalises SMS/email copy (template fallback if key/AI fails)
6. **Notify via API** (email preferred, SMS fallback)

n8n env needed: `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL`, `OPENROUTER_MODEL`, `YAKWETU_API_URL`, `INTERNAL_API_KEY`

parameters.url: ={{ ($env.YAKWETU_API_URL || 'http://sinema-api:3001') + '/api/internal/orders/' + encodeURIComponent($('Normalize abandon').item.json.orderId || 'latest') + '?userId=' + encodeURIComponent($('Normalize abandon').item.json.userId || '') + '&email=' + encodeURIComponent($('Normalize abandon').item.json.email || '') + '&phone=' + encodeURIComponent($('Normalize abandon').item.json.phone || '') + '&movieId=' + encodeURIComponent($('Normalize abandon').item.json.movieId || '') + '&movieTitle=' + encodeURIComponent($('Normalize abandon').item.json.movieTitle || '') + '&name=' + encodeURIComponent($('Normalize abandon').item.json.name || '') }}

nodes.name: Closest film to the cart (sinema-recs)
nodes.notes: If the recommender is down this answers empty and the offer falls back to the cart film alone.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ userId: $json.userId, orderId: $json.orderId, scenario: 'A_abandon', step: 'first', movieIds: $json.movieIds, discountPct: $json.discountPct, ttlMinutes: 60 }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: ($env.OPENROUTER_MODEL || 'openai/gpt-4o-mini'), temperature: 0.7, max_tokens: 140, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You write one short Yakwetu Sinema abandon nudge (Kenyan pay-per-film). Return JSON {"message": "..."}. Max 110 chars. Warm Kenyan English. Use only given facts (cart film, optional paired rec + why, price, discount). No links, emojis, or hashtags. End so a checkout link reads naturally after it.' },{ role: 'user', content: 'First name: ' + String($json.firstName||'') + '
' + 'Cart film: ' + String($json.cartTitle||$json.filmTitle||'') + '
' + 'Paired rec: ' + String($json.pickTitle||'none') + '
' + 'Why this rec: ' + String($json.pickReason||'') + '
' + 'Price: KES ' + String($json.totalKes) + ' (' + String($json.discountPct) + '% off)
' + 'Offer ends: 1 hour' }] }) }}

nodes.name: API already sent (skip n8n notify)
nodes.notes: Customer SMS/email is sent by paystack-api when the event is ingested. n8n must not send again (prevents 4x duplicates).
